script:
onRoleReachedMoon = function()
    game.pauseLogic()
	if global.isLevelPassed(28) and global.isLevelPassed(30) then
		if global.getBool("stg_b2") then dialog.setSkipEnabled(true) end
		repeat
			sound.play("49-1")
			if dialog.show("Stage2F-1", faceWunai) ==1 then break end
			if dialog.show("Stage2F-2", faceBujie) ==1 then break end
			if dialog.show("Stage2F-3", faceZhoumei) ==1 then break end
			if dialog.show("Stage2F-4", facePutong) ==1 then break end
			if dialog.show("Stage2F-5", faceDeyi) ==1 then break end
			sound.play("60-1")
			if dialog.show("Stage2F-6", faceManyi) ==1 then break end
			global.setBool("stg_b2")
		until true
		dialog.setSkipEnabled(false)
    end
    game.success()
end
